system_thesis_interpretation: The system under study is a fixed pretrained action/reasoning organism whose only same-life evidence source is an immutable public action--outcome log. It asks whether genuinely growing public causal information can be converted into connected, lossy, attributable experiential knowledge that improves fresh constructive action beyond native context, and whether explicit text or graph remains better than weights as lifetime length, compressibility, access, and causal intervention vary independently. Runtime credit is deliberately separated: DREAM may make target-independent local proposals but cannot establish truth; only later ordinary public outcomes may support or contradict them; SLEEP may deterministically canonicalize and materialize only supported nonrevoked predicates; MEMORY LoRA may transport or amortize admitted local associations but may neither discover them nor perform path reasoning; the reader plus recurrent THINK must reconstruct cited paths and take typed public actions. RANDOM is the exact-retention negative regime, MOTIF is the reusable-structure regime, and useful negative phase diagrams remain valid results. These bytes are only a proposal. Even a future exact human ratification would release only deterministic local CPU construction and negative-only falsification of the FeltCraft-Lifetimes instrument plus analytical comparison to the existing PCFL-Stream specification; it would not release PCFL-Stream implementation, scientific tokenization, any model/provider or weight operation, GPU/remote work, locked studies, promotion, or scientific claims.
graph_delta_interpretation: The causal/runtime graph has six responsibilities. N01 owns the matched super-seed x RANDOM/MOTIF x twin SCM, exact public kernel, and public-history-only source collector. N02 owns legal prefix cuts, disposable targets, matched outer-unit estimands, growth/resource accounting, and kill rules. N03 owns the organ boundary among frozen theta_0/theta_m and phi, immutable E, model-hidden append-only provenance G, bounded cited Z, one-operation THINK, one-proposal DREAM, chronological public-outcome grounding, and deterministic SLEEP compilation. N04 owns reset-per-life cumulative psi rebuilt from clean theta_m, identical-corpus text/LoRA comparisons, explicit graph and motif comparators, one-atom read interfaces, and complete hidden-work/resource ledgers; psi is unmounted while theta_0 composes and acts. N05 reserves the on-policy mediation and cross-life LOOP-controller systems for separate later studies. N06 is the reachability gate: proposal bytes have no executable edge, a future ratification may expose only the six canonical CPU scope atoms, and every later capability stays unreachable. The intended causal path is public transition -> immutable E -> target-blind DREAM proposal -> a later ordinary public outcome -> mechanical support/contradiction -> deterministic admission/compilation -> frozen memory substrate -> one local reader return -> bounded recurrent THINK -> at most one world action. Evaluation forks terminate in sealed reporting and have no back-edge to the life. Compilation changes representation and write/access strength, not truth; target evaluation, co-traversal, repeated views, model self-check, hidden oracle state, scores, and rejection state cannot create semantic evidence. Several edge endpoints are named as DREAM, ChronologicalGrounding, SLEEPCompiler, and SealedScorerAudit without corresponding node declarations in this delta, so referential closure must be resolved before this graph can serve as an executable capability graph.
loop_delta_interpretation: Only L01 is even potentially reachable under the first requested authority, and it remains dormant until exact human ratification of these bytes and exactly the canonical scope. It would run deterministic local CPU generation over a frozen 100--1000-super-seed policy, controllers, deck construction, structural/leakage/information/path/resource checks, rejection receipts, and an analysis-only comparison to PCFL-Stream, then stop with retain/rework/reject evidence. Its stop conditions are terminal and cannot promote to a later gate. L02 defines a future narrow THINK loop that consumes the current public state/outcome, bounded Z, and one reader atom, emits one typed operation, and may execute at most one action before the ordinary outcome. L03 defines a future DREAM--ground--SLEEP loop in which target-blind replay yields provisional local items, only later public evidence changes lifecycle status, compilation is deterministic, and a later separately authorized transport stage may rebuild psi from clean theta_m. L04 defines the common-deck loop: each method receives the identical legal prefix, transient state is cleared, memory is frozen, each target runs in a disposable clone, only reporting is written, and run-versus-skip suffixes must be identical. L05 keeps collection-memory assignment, collector x compiler crossing, mediation, and cross-life operation-token learning outside Paper 1 and behind new design/review/ratification. None of L02--L05 is authorized by this proposal or by a future green L01 receipt; no loop may authorize itself, repair its own failed predecessor, turn evaluation into experience, or infer a claim from execution.
claim_delta_interpretation: The present claim is strictly C_CPU_gate_only: a passing future CPU bakeoff would mean only that this instrument is eligible to request a disposable known-good text/model gate. It would establish no tokenizer-relative lifetime cut, model usability, shortcut resistance, compiler value, LoRA transport, scaling, saturation, mediation, flywheel, learned controller, or paper conclusion. C0 remains a separate PCFL-13 component-assay claim and cannot establish lifetime/compression. C1 can arise only from later frozen common-deck evidence beating every named primary baseline under simultaneous lower bounds and the registered .10 observed differences. C2 additionally requires three strictly post-native cuts, 1.8x unique-relation and enumerative-bit growth in both intervals, stable old/new panels, registered interval bounds, retention, and oracle headroom; failure to reject growth is not saturation. C3a requires a precommitted schema, a positive matched S difference-in-differences lower bound, at least .10 MOTIF action gain, and no spurious RANDOM gain. C3b additionally requires the frozen schema code/active memory to be shorter than enumerated atoms at matched loss; action improvement alone is generalization. C4 requires a later randomized collector x compiler and interventional mediation study that changes information action, subsequent memory, and sealed later action. C5 requires a separately trained cross-life operation-token-only LOOP adapter that improves unseen lives while frozen within life. The phase diagram is estimand zero: graph dominance, text success with LoRA failure, or absence of saturation are reportable negative outcomes. Attribution is local to the tested organ: DREAM proposal, public outcome evidence, SLEEP transformation, LoRA transport, and reader/THINK retrieval/composition. No priority, parametric moat, fixed-memory/fixed-compute, superiority, efficiency, scaling, compression, or causal-mediation language crosses its registered gate.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The 8 information classes x 7 stages form an exact 56-cell least-privilege contract. S01 may inspect hidden generation/oracle structure, targets, authority, and audit-derived records only to build and falsify the CPU instrument; it must not invoke scientific tokenizers, models, adapters, devices, networks, or later studies. S02 receives canonical public history, schedule position, and private counter RNG only; hidden recipes/bindings/rejection, targets/splits/scores, semantic memory, substrates, and authority metadata cannot influence collection. S03 may see only target-blind eligible public replay plus bounded local atom/workspace content; its hidden I01 cell means no live or held-out target goal, while visible I02 permits selected past public outcomes. It cannot see truth, targets, global claim status, substrate metadata, or authority. S04 may see public roots/outcomes and internally auditable lifecycle/provenance/compiler state but not hidden world truth, evaluation, or cognitive workspace as evidence. S05 lets THINK see the current public goal/state/outcome and bounded Z while the reader receives only a copied public type/anchor and returns one atom or NOT_FOUND; raw lifetime history, global status/provenance, split metadata, hidden truth, and authority remain inaccessible, and backend internals are hidden behind the ledgered interface. S06 is a sealed audit/scoring principal allowed to compare target behavior, hidden truth, provenance, and resource data, but it writes only to a disjoint reporting namespace and no byte returns to life state. S07 permits only future separately authorized derived public trajectories and operation-token data; hidden truth/proofs/scores, evaluation bytes, and within-life authority remain forbidden. In systems terms, visible means available to the named trusted stage, derived_only means only a contract-preserving derivative crosses, hidden means internal to a trusted subcomponent but withheld from cognition, and forbidden means no dataflow or side channel; runtime taint, process, RNG, cache, and namespace boundaries must enforce these labels rather than relying on prompts.
acceptance_test_interpretation: AT01_change_hash_scope_and_independent_review is a current deliberation/intake check: change.json must validate, its four declared context hashes must match, the visibility matrix must contain exactly 56 unique cells, state must remain proposed, and any future ratification must bind exactly the six sorted requested_scope atoms and seven sorted forbidden_scope atoms in scope_proposal.json. Passing AT01 creates no authority. AT02_CPU_capability_firewall is a future post-ratification, pre-side-effect closed-world reachability test: only local deterministic FeltCraft generation, controllers, deck construction, leakage/information/path/resource checks, evidence, and analytical use of the existing PCFL-Stream specification may be reachable; device, credential, network, tokenizer/model/provider, adapter/weight, scientific split, promotion, and PCFL-Stream implementation paths must deny before side effects. AT03_world_quadruplet_determinism_and_kernel requires 100--1000 matched quadruplets, byte-identical replay under order/suffix perturbation, namespace isolation, tau involution and binding equivariance, coupled nuisance streams, pure public collector behavior under identical public histories, exhaustive kernel/reset/inventory properties, and complete symmetric rejection receipts. AT04_target_collision_headroom_and_leakage binds accepted A0/A2/A3/S cohorts jointly across all four cells: target-visible bytes/action opportunities/difficulty are matched; twin decisive sets map and flip equivariantly; exact-memory and hidden-oracle cohort success are at least .85 in each cell; no-memory, brute force, and each target/state/identifier/descriptor/passive probe are at most .35; source-target state/goal/plan/decisive-sequence collisions are absent; and S is legal-prefix identifiable only in MOTIF. AT05_information_growth_MDL_paths_and_resources requires reproducible complete-cut N_unique_public_edges, frozen L_enum and L_schema, exact target conditional entropies, schema action gain, shortest paths, candidate/graph-work curves, target yield, rejection rates, and complete CPU resources without a scientific tokenizer. Unique information and L_enum must grow; only MOTIF may show prospective S schema gain, RANDOM remains the exact-retention negative control, and no compression conclusion follows merely from action gain or suggestive MDL. AT06_evaluation_suffix_noninterference requires disposable run-versus-skip target forks, zero-for-failure without replacement, destruction of target processes, denial of writes outside reporting, canaries over every evaluation-derived goal/query/read/path/action/outcome/replay/RNG/cache/audit channel, and identical later authorized-state hashes; under the current scope this cannot silently authorize implementation of the future scientific compiler, substrate, or adapter. AT07_future_representation_transport_and_causal_gates is dormant until later exact authorizations: known-good text must meet .85/.35, compiled text must gain .10 versus raw RAG/A-MEM without RANDOM schema gain, LoRA must reach .90 atomic fidelity, action within -.10 of identical text, and direct-QA improvement in at least 4/6, learned DREAM must recover 70% of gold gain with unsupported commits below 5%, and same-corpus, randomized whole-memory assignment, coherent twin swap, cited-root masks, and negative-control masks must localize credit without allowing a failed predecessor to promote. AT08_estimands_statistics_resources_and_claim_firewall is a future pre-confirmation freeze: named baselines/DEV configurations, equal target counts, K=2 nested adapter seeds, 24--48 matched-super-seed size selected by blinded variance-only simulation, zero-for-failure, hierarchical families, common outer-cluster simultaneous inference, MDL/resources, and permitted language must be fixed. C1 needs every simultaneous lower bound above zero plus every observed MOTIF 8L difference at least .10; C2 needs both registered post-native interval bounds and -.05 old-retention protection; C3 needs the S difference-in-differences and the separate MDL criterion; generative versus recognition transport and causal interventions remain separate. AT09_no_automatic_promotion requires denial of proposal-to-CPU execution without exact ratification and denial of every CPU-to-tokenizer/model/LoRA/GPU/remote/locked/on-policy/LOOP/claim transition without its own predecessor evidence, frozen bytes/scope, deliberation, independent review, and human authorization; a supporting author advocate cannot override a rejecting independent reviewer. Collectively these tests are proposed gates, not evidence that the instrument is fully specified, implemented, feasible, valid, approved, or scientifically successful.
assumptions: The six requested_scope atoms are interpreted as an exhaustive closed-world authorization set: an operation absent from that set remains unauthorized even when it is not repeated as a standalone forbidden_scope atom.

The world_contract.md controls wherever proposal.md is less specific, while change.json controls the deliberation object, acceptance tests, and authority boundary; any irreconcilable conflict requires a reviewed revision rather than interpreter choice.

Visibility labels describe access by the named trusted stage, not blanket access by every process or model inside that stage; cognition receives only the narrower channels stated in each cell reason and organ contract.

All CPU acceptance rates and contrasts use the matched super-seed/quadruplet and predeclared cohort as their unit or denominator, never favorable per-target retention, and failures remain zero as explicitly required.

Analytical PCFL-Stream comparison means read-only reasoning over the already existing specification and locally produced FeltCraft evidence, with no PCFL-Stream code, generator, deck, or execution path created.

ambiguities.impact: The public-policy purity constraint is clear, but the exact source/target bytes, information growth, acceptance denominators, yield, resource curves, and reproducible terminal point cannot be derived from the current proposal bytes alone.

ambiguities.impact: Different involutive derangements can change grammar-valid actions, shortest paths, target feasibility, and decisive-set mappings, so AT03 equivariance and AT04 matched difficulty are underdetermined until tau is concretely frozen.

ambiguities.question: What exact logical identification rule defines an edge as identified from the public prefix, and what complete prefix code, template-ID codebook, permutation code, provenance-reference code, deviation/exception code, and numeric precision define L_enum and L_schema?
ambiguities.impact: AT05 cannot be independently reproduced or used to distinguish growth, prospective identifiability, and measured compression from implementation choices until these functions are hash-bound before sampling.

ambiguities.question: What are the frozen cohort sizes and aggregation denominators for the .85/.35 gates, what minimum positive schema_action_gain is required in MOTIF, and is the phrase 'potentially shorter L_schema' merely descriptive or a CPU eligibility condition?
ambiguities.impact: Joint acceptance and AT04 have threshold directions but incomplete sample/aggregation definitions, while part of AT05 is not a binary falsification criterion; distinct compliant implementations could issue different retain/rework/reject verdicts.

ambiguities.question: Which frozen entry points, transitive imports/resources, subprocesses, environment variables, filesystem roots, network/device APIs, and operating-system enforcement boundary constitute the complete capability graph for AT02?
ambiguities.impact: Enumerating known commands and refusal cases does not by itself prove that every forbidden transition fails before side effects; a closed manifest and runtime enforcement boundary are needed for the universal expected result.

ambiguities.question: Does the frozen constant-size candidate constructor constrain only assisted recognition reads, or also headline generative one-atom reads, and what work may a generative backend perform before returning one atom or NOT_FOUND?
ambiguities.impact: Future same-interface comparisons, hidden-work accounting, candidate/graph curves, and any scalable parametric-read claim depend on whether candidate construction and output-vocabulary costs are common across both read modes.

ambiguities.question: For AT06 under the six-atom CPU scope, are compiler/memory hashes limited to inert deterministic fixtures/manifests, or does the test intend real SLEEP compiler and memory-substrate implementation?
ambiguities.impact: The latter would expand beyond the stated negative-only generator/controller/deck/test scope and conflict with dormant N03/N04 stages; the former can prove only CPU-harness noninterference, not future model/compiler/adapter isolation.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The current world contract is causally specific but is not yet an exact executable deterministic specification from these bytes alone.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The source schedule, budgets, cohort cardinalities, 100--1000 stopping rule, tau construction, identification rule, and MDL code are material inputs to the registered acceptance verdicts but are left for a future implementer. Hash-valid implementations can therefore differ in accepted worlds, information growth, schema gain, resources, and retain/rework/reject outcome.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Keep this artifact proposal-only. Before any CPU evidence run, freeze a hash-bound implementation/specification manifest and deterministic golden fixtures covering these choices, subject them to fresh independent review, and require a new architecture change if any choice alters the frozen causal manipulation, cohorts, thresholds, estimands, visibility, or claim boundary.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: AT02's universal claim that every forbidden capability fails closed cannot be established by enumerating imports, commands, credentials, and refusal cases alone.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Unlisted dynamic imports, subprocesses, filesystem-discovered plugins, environment-controlled backends, device APIs, and network libraries can remain reachable even when named negative tests pass.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Bind the CPU runner to a closed entry-point and transitive dependency/resource manifest, a denied-by-default filesystem/network/device/process policy, a credential-free environment, and static plus dynamic closure receipts; treat any unclassified capability as forbidden before side effects.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The AT05 expectation that MOTIF shows 'potentially shorter L_schema' is not an exact pass/fail condition.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Potentially shorter admits any observed ordering and therefore cannot determine whether the instrument passes, while the surrounding bytes correctly reserve an actual compression conclusion for C3b after prospective gain and a frozen shorter-code criterion.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Adjudicate AT05 as requiring exact preregistered reporting of L_schema and L_enum without a CPU shorter-code threshold, or revise the change to bind a specific CPU eligibility inequality; in either case preserve that no compression claim arises at this gate.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: AT06 cannot require implementation or execution of the future scientific SLEEP compiler, memory substrates, or adapters under the proposed six-atom CPU authority.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: N03/N04 model/transport systems are explicitly dormant, while the requested scope is limited to the new world, paired construction, decks, CPU tests/evidence, and analytical PCFL comparison. Literal future compiler/memory hashes would either be unavailable or silently broaden authority.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Under the first scope, hash only authorized source/deck/controller/evidence state plus inert canary fixtures and report that limited guarantee. Re-test end-to-end compiler/substrate/adapter suffix noninterference under each later separately ratified stage; if real compiler implementation is intended now, revise and re-deliberate the canonical scope before ratification.
